items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I enjoy more playing with the Rolf's brass band... This band is too noisy and it's mainly because of Baptiste... So we managed to get him to play some other songs

ctx.x: Yeah. What did you think of the band?

Oh I think it's pretty bad. I mean I enjoy more playing with the Rolf's brass band. Sounds more like the Eureka brass band or something like that. This band is too noisy and it's mainly because of Baptiste, which the awful trumpet player.
Well I had a hard time hearing you play your E flat a lot of times.
